response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_cnt FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS overall_avg FROM per), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_cnt, p.avg_cnt - o.overall_avg AS diff_overall FROM per p, overall o WHERE p.avg_cnt > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS k_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_cnt AS avg_anlycount, k.diff_overall AS above_overall_avg, k.avg_cnt - ka.k_avg AS above_kept_avg FROM kept k, kept_avg ka ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the unweighted mean of per-transaction averages (each transaction counts once), as the request states. Transactions whose anlycount values are all NULL have a NULL average and are excluded from both the overall average and the kept set.

The 'average among just the kept transactions' is the mean of the kept per-transaction averages. Ordering by the last difference is the same as ordering by average, and NULLs sort last in a descending order only if they exist (SQLite puts NULLs last for DESC), though none can occur among kept rows.
